The sole endpoint difference is that left.manifest carries audit_timestamp="2026-07-27T12:00:00Z" while right.manifest is empty. Therefore S(left) === S(right): the protected semantic-snapshot relation is PRESERVED. This case exercises exactly the non-elevation guarantee: a manifest-level audit_timestamp appearing on one side does not change semantic identity.

code.description: Node ESM harness. canonicalize() is a byte-faithful port of source-material/canonicalize.ts (only TypeScript type-only syntax ': unknown', 'as Record<string, unknown>', and 'export ' removed; runtime logic identical). Adds a recursive reserved-key scan of $semantic_artifact for own-key 'audit_timestamp' at any depth and an accepted-scalar-domain check, then compares left/right semantic snapshots per case. commit_note: not yet committed to a separate repository; the reviewer assigns the freeze commit for DERIVATION.json and this harness at submission freeze.

method.derivation_route: For each endpoint {manifest, semantic_artifact}, define the semantic snapshot S = canonicalize(semantic_artifact), computed by the supplied source serializer, and valid only if the artifact is accepted: (a) no own property named audit_timestamp at any object depth inside $semantic_artifact (reserved-field rule), and (b) every scalar is in {null, finite number, boolean, string} (accepted scalar domain). The manifest and any audit_timestamp in it are non-semantic (Audit metadata domain) and are excluded from S. Classification: PRESERVED iff both endpoints are accepted and S(left) === S(right); VIOLATED iff both are accepted and S(left) !== S(right); UNVERIFIABLE iff acceptance or the snapshot cannot be established from the supplied evidence (e.g. rejection asymmetry, or a decision requiring descriptor-level facts the flat inputs do not expose). Under the README scope (flat printable ASCII string objects, no custom descriptors) descriptor inspection reduces to the plain JSON structure, so the accepted snapshot equals canonicalize(semantic_artifact).
method.external_evidence_used: None. Derivation used only the supplied pack files. The upstream repository pipavlo82/crystal-receipt was not browsed; no prior solution, report, predictor code, reproducer output, or external commentary was consulted. Input-origin selectors are withheld by the pack and were not needed to derive the semantic-snapshot relation from the supplied bytes.
method.integrity_checks: Ran `sha256sum -c HASHES.sha256` from the pack root: all 13 listed files OK. The input JSON bytes and canonicalize.ts bytes used by the harness were independently re-hashed and matched their SOURCE_PINS.json / HASHES.sha256 digests before derivation. SHA-256 of the received HASHES.sha256 bytes = 7043e00225a908cbccf8b5ea01f3b205a5983a1a562977d2118174c58b7533b3. semantic-domain.md and canonicalize.ts reproduce their included_sha256 values. PACK-LEAKAGE-AUDIT.md and PACK_MANIFEST.json were read to confirm no case answer key is present.
